parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same root cause: on the denied path, the refilled tokens are stored in bucket.tokens but updated_at is not advanced to now, so the same elapsed interval is credited again on subsequent calls, letting a throttled client exceed the configured rate. Description B gives a concrete worked example, while Description A gives a different numeric example, but the defect and location are the same.
